steps.npc: Hello there. Would you like to see the goods I have for sale?

options.text: Why do you have so much wool in your store?

steps.player: Why do you have so much wool in your store? I haven't seen any sheep anywhere.

steps.npc: Ah, I have contacts on the mainland. I have a sailor friend who brings me crates of wool on a regular basis.

steps.player: What do you trade for it?

steps.npc: Rope of course! What else can we sell? Fish would go off before it got so far south.

steps.player: Where does all this rope go?

steps.npc: Err, I don't remember the name of the place very well. Dreinna? Drennor? Something like that.
Would you like to see the goods I have for sale?
